arguments.source:
repos = github.search_repositories(query="agent framework", limit=30)
details = map(repos, github.get_repository(full_name=_.full_name))
r = compute(details, ratio="forks / stars")
high_ratio = select(r, "ratio > 0.15")
low_ratio = select(r, "ratio <= 0.15")
high_scores = map(high_ratio, github.get_contributor_stats(full_name=_.full_name))
low_scores = map(low_ratio, github.list_commits(full_name=_.full_name))
all_scores = concat(high_scores, low_scores)
valid = select(all_scores, "score >= 100")
ranked = sort(valid, key="score", desc=true)
top = take(ranked, 3)
return top

ranked = sort(remaining, key="score", desc=true)
top = take(ranked, 3)
